Class LotteryAPI

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.lottery.api.LotteryAPI
public final class LotteryAPI extends Object
The lottery, for other plugins. Declare "AtomicTempest:Lottery": "*" under Dependencies (or OptionalDependencies, and check isAvailable()) in your manifest.json. Winners, ticket sales and draws are also reported through Coins' PlayerActions and WalletEvents, which need no Lottery dependency.

Safe to call from any thread.
